behavior: Collects the selected OS/application architecture, release, first processor model, logical count and memory fields; unavailable sources do not invalidate independently collected fields.

Windows version/CIM processor JSON is validated with the Source integer/null/string rules. Unsupported/missing architecture and physical-core metadata receive fixed reasons. Registry version components and CPU socket counts are not inferred from logical count.
macOS version/build and sysctl output follow the Source line parsing, suffix consistency and safe integer rules. Other platforms expose the four unsupported metadata reasons.

Version and processor queries start concurrently. Missing SystemRoot issues no Windows query; malformed JSON, absent/null fields, query failures, timeouts and output limits affect only their dependent fields.
Product metadata contains selected values and fixed reasons; raw command output and errors remain outside the emitted field object.
limitations: This collector requires explicit OS/query ports and is not activated by the product-analytics service yet. No real subprocess, Windows 7 metadata sampling or cancellation qualification is claimed in this batch.

The exact Source PowerShell commands may be unavailable on older PowerShell installations; the eventual executor must report the fixed query failure without requiring an OS patch. Full migration/release, Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.
